changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO work_material_consumptions ( work_item_id, offer_package_id, material_unit_id, branch, construction_material_type_id, finishing_material_type_id, norm_qty, waste_pct, justification_ru, justification_pl, source_type, source_doc, source_url, source_ref, created_date, created_by) SELECT wi.id, op.id, u.id, 'construction', tp.id, NULL, 0.10, 0, 'Защита расходует ~0.10 м2 плёнки на 1 м2 защищаемой поверхности; якорь Excel 0.10 шт/м2 нормализован в м2 плёнки.', 'Zabezpieczenie zuzywa ~0.10 m2 folii na 1 m2 chronionej powierzchni; anchor Excela 0.10 szt/m2 znormalizowany do m2 folii.', 'excel', 'Excel Matrix v3.0 Oferta', NULL, 'wiersz 1.01 arkusza Oferta, kolumna folia ochronna 0.10', NOW(), 'seed:for-04-19' FROM work_items wi, offer_packages op, measurement_units u, construction_material_types tp WHERE wi.code = '1.01' AND op.code = 'budget' AND u.code = 'm2' AND tp.code = 'FOLIA_OCHRONNA' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM work_material_consumptions w WHERE w.work_item_id = wi.id AND w.offer_package_id = op.id AND w.branch = 'construction' AND w.material_unit_id = u.id AND w.construction_material_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM tp.id AND w.norm_qty IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 0.10 );
